steps.request: Keep track of our customers: their name, their city and the date they signed up. Each customer also has one account with a balance in euros that can never go negative.
Ana from Lisbon signed up on 2026-09-01 with 120 euros in her account.
Ben from Porto signed up on 2026-09-15; his account starts with 30 euros.
Carla from Lisbon signed up on 2026-10-01 with an empty account.
How many customers live in Lisbon?
Move 50 euros from Ana's account to Ben's.
Move 100 euros from Ben's account to Carla's, all or nothing.
What is each customer's name and balance, highest balance first?
Which cities have more than one customer?
